cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to acquire a set of knowledge and skills necessary for the correct choice of material and construction solutions for building components of gardens and parks. Students will acquire basic skills for drawing necessary construction drawings and for working with construction drawings.
